items.text: Chad Koppie is a retired Delta Airlines pilot and farmer, and a member of the Kane County Regional Board of School Trustees. He has served as president of that board and previously was a Rutland Township trustee and a District 300 school board member. His campaign website also lists him as a board member of the Illinois Forum. He is a U.S. Army veteran.

sentences.text: Chad Koppie is a retired Delta Airlines pilot and farmer, and a member of the Kane County Regional Board of School Trustees.
He has served as president of that board and previously was a Rutland Township trustee and a District 300 school board member.
His campaign website also lists him as a board member of the Illinois Forum.
He is a U.S. Army veteran.

items.text: Koppie wants to ban abortion by a constitutional amendment stating that human life begins at conception. He has called abortion a moral issue and compared it to slavery. He opposes sanctuary policies for undocumented immigrants. He has called for repealing Illinois' SAFE-T Act and strengthening law enforcement to hold violent offenders accountable.

He has called abortion a moral issue and compared it to slavery.
He opposes sanctuary policies for undocumented immigrants.
He has called for repealing Illinois' SAFE-T Act and strengthening law enforcement to hold violent offenders accountable.

items.text: On fiscal issues, he proposes cutting all government spending by 3% each year for 10 years, abolishing the Federal Reserve and the IRS, eliminating the U.S. Department of Education, and ending all foreign aid. He would repeal the Affordable Care Act. He argues that fraud by hospitals and insurance companies drives high healthcare costs. He has stated he does not believe Joe Biden was the duly elected president. During his 2024 campaign, he said he was a lifetime member of the NRA and would defend the Second Amendment.
